task: Rename package, CLI and public Git repository to ed-killer
rules: AGENTS.md governs a breaking namespace rename without changing validation behavior, dependency direction or effect ownership. Move every runtime module to ed_killer; distribute and invoke it as ed-killer. Preserve completed architecture records. Reuse runtime and release import contracts against the new namespace. The existing local release helper and its private persistent identifiers remain unchanged to preserve hook ownership, locking and recovery compatibility. Rename the existing public GitHub repository, retaining its identity, history and tags; publish only checked commits and Git tags.

modules.interface: schema_for, validate_dataframe, validate_csv, issue/options/result and input error types.
modules.effects: Imports only; CSV/image effects occur solely through explicit calls.

modules.interface: Delegate to cli.main and exit with its status.
modules.effects: Runs the CLI only as the module entrypoint.

modules.responsibility: Share null and exact integer/numeric cell semantics.
modules.interface: is_missing, number and integer accept original scalar cells without mutation.

modules.interface: find_duplicates(frame, groups, threshold) returns positional issues; opaque/cyclic extras warn.

With check_images=True, directly resolves local filesystem paths/symlinks for identity; image reads and decoding cross explicit media functions. This direct optional adapter edge is deliberate for the standalone local-only API.

contracts.rules: Validation/schema/geometry/media cannot import CLI, report output or CSV input, directly or transitively.
Exhaustive module layers descend from __main__, cli, csv_io|reporting, validation, schema|geometry|media, cells|models. Same-level modules are independent; no upward dependencies.
The package facade imports only the four approved public API modules and has only docstring/import/export declarations; no import-time file/logging/process effects.
Mutated temporary package imports into outer I/O, across independent adapters and into models are rejected by the real linter; the real package remains unchanged.
The report-output adapter cannot import validation, directly or transitively; results arrive through the public result model.

Every package source module prohibits imports of cveta2 and clearml_yolo, including aliases, submodules, type-only and lazy Import/ImportFrom statements. Current source has no dynamic import mechanism.
Release helper cannot import ed_killer or consumers; renamed runtime cannot import release tools; dev-only release dependencies and tag-only policy remain enforced, including negative controls.

checks.expectation: All original and expanded import contracts pass for the actual source tree.
Real imports and facade pass, and prohibited injected dependency/import-time-effect cases fail their contracts.
Full behavior and architecture suite passes on the development interpreter.
Full suite passes on the minimum supported interpreter; alternate isolated environment path may be selected for verification.
